answer: Each identity registers at one jetty and files a key-signed kernel manifest of its work on the jetty board, posting a 40-credit bond returned after a clean epoch plus a congestion fee: at a jetty holding n registrations it is 20 plus 5n, so the k-th fake on one jetty pays 15 plus 5k; 1,000 on one jetty cost 2,517,500. New jetties cost a 500-credit orchard surety each, locked for a clean epoch. A port-sprawl ring opening 200 shell jetties locks 100,000, and underpaid fees are caught by recomputation from the public board, burning the bond. An honest agent pays one fee and recovers its bond.
